repairs.reason: Terminal-suffix native td_debug emits malformed optional JSON. The old evaluator collected this before writing terminal cash/action fields, turning completed games into report failures.
repairs.resolution: Write terminal outcome first. Catch only JSONDecodeError from the optional final debug call; preserve its error, raw-byte hash and first 512 bytes. Run a new full preflight on every candidate.
repairs.scope: Only terminal diagnostic collection in the isolated evaluator; all policy, simulator, configuration and opponent bytes unchanged.
